title: A session burned through a quarter million tokens in one loop, a call every two seconds for four minutes
narrative: The runaway loop: one hundred and thirty identical tool calls in under four and a half minutes, machine speed without pause, where supervised agentic work has gaps — the rate the tool-burst correlation exists to name.

benign-twin.title: A heavy but honest coding session: sixty calls with pauses, inside the hour the burst rule's own comment sets aside for it
benign-twin.narrative: The correlation's threshold sits above a busy human-supervised session and below machine speed, and this twin is the lower edge of that argument made concrete: sixty calls in twelve minutes is a hard day's agentic work, and it must not fire.

blind: The spend itself is not a number anything sums: the store keeps per-call token strings and no session total, so a session-wide budget breach — the cost bomb proper, catalogue B14 — has no rule and no field. What fires here is the rate proxy, the burst, which catches the loop shape and not the bill; a patient bomb under one call every seven and a half seconds is invisible to this pack, and the pack's own comments say so.
